entry.title: Disclosure: DoS vulnerabilities fixed in Eclair v0.14.1
entry.summary: Understanding the responsibilities associated with upgrades in the context of using mobile Lightning wallets, particularly for non-technical users, involves recognizing who is accountable for performing these updates. Users of mobile Lightning wallets are not typically required to undertake any actions related to upgrading the system themselves. Instead, this responsibility falls on the operators of the Eclair nodes or backend systems that support these wallets. Clarifying this division of responsibility can significantly aid those who may not have a technical background but use these services, ensuring they understand their role and whether any action is needed from their side when updates occur. This understanding helps prevent confusion and ensures that users are aware of the extent of their responsibilities, contributing to smoother operation and maintenance of the technology they rely on.
